# Oboard

Oboard is an objectives and key results platform for managing goals, progress, teams, and workspaces.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/oboard/.

## Actions

- **Add Users to Group**: Add one or more existing Oboard users to a group.
- **Create Check-In**: Create a check-in that records a progress value, status, or comment for an Oboard element.
- **Create Element**: Create an Oboard objective, key result, or Jira-linked element in a workspace and interval.
- **Create Element Value**: Create a dated numeric value for an Oboard element.
- **Create Group**: Create an Oboard group in selected workspaces or all workspaces.
- **Create Strategic Component**: Create an Oboard strategic component with its ordering, type, workspace placement, and element rules.
- **Delete Element**: Delete one Oboard element and optionally its nested objectives.
- **Delete Element Value**: Delete one dated value record from an Oboard element.
- **Delete Group**: Delete one Oboard group, optionally deleting its users too.
- **Get Element** (read-only): Retrieve one current Oboard element by its numeric ID.
- **List Child Elements** (read-only): List and filter current child elements below a parent, including manual-weight metadata, one page at a time.
- **List Confidence Levels** (read-only): List Oboard confidence-level IDs and names, optionally restricted to accessible workspaces.
- **List Custom Fields** (read-only): List Oboard custom-field definitions across accessible workspaces.
- **List Element Comments** (read-only): Retrieve comments for one or more Oboard elements.
- **List Element Progress History** (read-only): Retrieve dated progress values for multiple Oboard elements, one page at a time.
- **List Element Values** (read-only): List all dated values recorded for one Oboard element.
- **List Elements** (read-only): List and filter current Oboard objectives, key results, and Jira-linked elements, one page at a time.
- **List Groups** (read-only): List current Oboard groups and their workspace, permission, synchronization, and user-count metadata.
- **List Intervals** (read-only): List planning intervals, dates, and open or backlog state for one workspace.
- **List Labels** (read-only): List current Oboard labels, optionally filtered by name.
- **List Strategic Components** (read-only): List current Oboard strategic components, optionally filtered by component or workspace IDs.
- **List Users** (read-only): Search current Oboard users across workspaces, roles, and groups, one page at a time.
- **List Workspaces** (read-only): List workspaces accessible to the connected Oboard API token.
- **Remove Users from Group**: Remove one or more existing Oboard users from a group.
- **Replace Element**: Update an existing Oboard element through its broad PUT operation, which can set editable metadata, hierarchy, progress, assignments,…
- **Replace Group**: Replace the settings, workspace links, platform links, and membership list of an existing Oboard group.
- **Search Check-Ins** (read-only): Search check-ins for selected elements and optionally include element or comment details, one page at a time.
- **Update Check-In**: Update an existing Oboard check-in's progress value, status, or comment.
- **Update Element Properties**: Update one or more named properties on an existing Oboard element without replacing the complete element.
- **Update Element Value**: Update the numeric value of one Oboard element-value record.
- **Update Strategic Component**: Update an existing Oboard strategic component's identity, ordering, and element rules.
- **Update User Roles**: Bulk update users' workspace roles.
